name: refactor_rust_manual_loop_to_iterator_chain
description: Refactors a manual index-based while loop into an iterator chain (enumerate/map/collect)
prompts: ranked_labels(scores: &[i32]) -> Vec<String> in src/lib.rs builds one "<rank>: <score>" label per score (1-based rank, in input order) using a manual index-based `while` loop with a mutable counter. Refactor it to use an iterator chain instead - `.iter().enumerate()` (or `.iter().zip(1..)`), `.map(...)`, `.collect()` - with no manual index variable or while loop. Do not change observable behavior: the output must be the exact same Vec<String> in the exact same order for any input, including an empty slice returning an empty Vec. Keep the function name and signature.

reference_solution.src/lib.rs:
pub fn ranked_labels(scores: &[i32]) -> Vec<String> {
    scores
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, score)| format!("{}: {}", i + 1, score))
        .collect()
}
